Radianz was originally formed as a joint venture, providing a shared low latency financial extranet connecting banks, exchanges, and financial services firms to reduce the cost and complexity of maintaining separate point to point network connections for market data and trading; BT, the British telecommunications company formally known as BT Group, acquired the Radianz business in 2005 and rebranded it BT Radianz, continuing to operate it as part of BTs financial services connectivity offerings.
